verified_fact: Amarnath cave in Kashmir at 3,888 m houses a naturally formed ice Shivalinga that waxes and wanes with the moon. Legend: Shiva told Parvati the secret of immortality (Amar Katha) here — two doves overheard and became immortal, still said to inhabit the cave.
voiceover_script: 3,888 meter ki unchaai par ek gupha — jahaan Mahadev ne Parvati ko bathaai Amar Katha — amar hone ka rahasya! Ye thi Amarnath gupha. Shiv socha — koi nahi sun raha. Par do kabootar chhup ke sun rahe the — wo bhi amar ho gaye! Kaha jaata hai aaj bhi wo kabootar wahan milte hain. Aur gupha mein ice ka Shivalinga — Poornima par badata hai, Amavasya par ghatta hai!

🔱 Amarnath cave Shiva immortality story Parvati ice linga

Amarnath cave in Kashmir at 3,888 m houses a naturally formed ice Shivalinga that waxes and wanes with the moon. Legend: Shiva told Parvati the secret of immortality (Amar Katha) here — two doves overheard and became immortal, still said to inhabit the cave.
